issues.description: Urgent request from Northwind. Added mid-sprint by PM.
Shared state between tests caused intermittent 409s.

Finance needs to record payment of an issued invoice.

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /invoices/{id}/pay marks the invoice as Paid and sets PaidAt.
- Only users with the billing or admin role may call it.
- The invoice must belong to the caller's tenant; otherwise respond 404.
- Only Issued invoices can be paid; Draft, Paid and Void respond 409.
- Endpoint and domain tests cover all of the above.
